title: NEXUS autonomous work cycle acceptance
head: 51a8ab6c8d1e43860775777aaaeebf908bc432e0

checks.name: Ax and NEXUS complete an authenticated, persisted, idempotent exchange end to end
NEXUS advances a low-risk planned objective without an owner in the loop
an approval-gated objective is never started autonomously and the command token cannot approve it
the scheduler completes an agent-oriented mission autonomously and verifies it
1-2-3: an objective is persisted, decomposed by the Director, and research returns cited evidence
4: the engineering agent detects a real failing check and proposes a tested correction without writing
5: an interrupted mission resumes without repeating the work that already produced evidence
6: a plan that needs an owner is refused before any agent runs
7: results and evidence survive a new service instance over the same durable store
8: a mission result is sent through the authenticated Ax bridge, and both surfaces reject a missing token
9: failures are reported as failures, never as completed
10: a multi-agent objective reaches a verified completion with memory, audit and a result message
11: an operator stop halts the mission between steps and a later run resumes it
director and verification are assigned by role only, never auto-routed

operational: durable objective receipt, understanding, planning, authorization and execution transitions
deterministic Director plan routed to memory, research, engineering, operations, security and verification
read-only repository research with file/line citations and digests
allowlisted engineering inspection with node --check and a test-backed correction proposal
per-step evidence persistence and resume without repeating finished work
independent verification against acceptance criteria before completion
memory write after a verified completion
authenticated NEXUS->Ax result and progress messages with a stable correlation id
scheduler autonomy drives agent-oriented objectives through the work cycle
stop and revoke controls with audit events
notVerifiedHere: No OpenAI or other model call: the Director plan is deterministic, so model planning quality is not measured.
No Cloudflare D1 or Render deployment: the acceptance run uses memory repositories with the same CAS contract.
No Android device, no APK build, no release gate and no production migration.
The signature/verification check is keyword-based evidence coverage, not semantic proof.
An in-flight agent call cannot be interrupted mid-call; stop takes effect before the next step.
